### Highlights

#### 🔌 Connecting no longer waits for you to log in
Some people saw "Can't reach League" every time, on a client that was running fine.

- League RPC decided whether the League Client was alive by asking it who was logged in. At the login screen nobody is, so a client that was up and answering got treated as dead, and League RPC kept waiting instead of connecting.
- With Debug logging on, the reason a connection attempt failed now goes into the app's own log, so Copy diagnostics carries it into a bug report.

#### 💬 Discord forks count as Discord
If you run Vesktop instead of Discord, League RPC did nothing at all.

- League RPC looked for `Discord.exe` and nothing else, so it never even tried to connect. It now also looks for Vesktop, Legcord, ArmCord, and Discord's PTB, Canary and Development builds.
- Vesktop needs its own Rich Presence setting turned on, under Vesktop Settings, for presence to reach Discord.
